inputDomains.policy: every value is defined and exactly modelled; each case reads the domain where the previous case of its family stopped, so a family's cases cover its whole domain

operatorModel.integers: C++ semantics after integral promotion: two's complement wrap; Abs, Negative and Square inputs that overflow int or the signed type are excluded
operatorModel.bool: promoted to int, converted back to bool
operatorModel.rounding: ceil, floor and rint exact with the sign of zero kept
operatorModel.transcendental: only at signed zeros, infinities, NaN, poles, domain errors and overflow, underflow or saturation thresholds valid in every evaluation width
operatorModel.complex64: unary_ops.h, complex.h, cexpf.h and utils.h formulas with exact binary32 intermediates
operatorModel.fp8: fp8.h E4M3 bit algorithm: saturating round-to-nearest-even encoding, binary16-based decoding of all 256 codes
